verdict.rationale: Kit's documented sending API covers only broadcasts drafted or scheduled to all subscribers or to segment/tag subsets. The evidence shows no endpoint for one-to-one transactional sends such as receipts or magic links. Broadcast targeting is an adjacent marketing capability, not per-recipient transactional delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
